# bilibili-mcp - Full Documentation

Content-intelligence bridge for Bilibili (B站), China's largest video
platform. Search, trending, video intel and transcript summarisation. No
account needed for the core tier.

## Overview

bilibili-mcp lets an agent search, rank, inspect and summarise Bilibili
videos. The killer feature is reading a video's auto-subtitle track as plain
text so an LLM can summarise or translate it. It does NOT play video, and
does NOT automate uploading or commenting.

## Execution

- Mode: API bridge (no host app, no GUI). Talks to Bilibili public web APIs
  over HTTPS.
- Tiers: Anonymous (no account) powers explore/search/video/transcript.
  Account tier (a +86 login cookie `BILIBILI_COOKIE`) unlocks following and
  favorites.
- Backend 11185 (FastAPI + FastMCP `/mcp` + REST `/api`), frontend 11186
  (Vite React).

## MCP Tools

All tools return a structured dict `{success, message, ...}`; failures add
`error`, `error_type`, `suggestions`.

### bilibili_explore(operation, limit, rid)
- `trending` - popular feed (anonymous). Returns `data[]` of slim videos.
- `rank` - all-region ranking; rid 0=all 1=anime 3=music 4=game
  5=entertainment 36=knowledge 160=fashion.
- `hot_search` - trending search keywords: `data[]` of `{keyword, heat}`.

### bilibili_search(operation, keyword, limit)
- `video` - search video titles.
- `user` - search creators.
May be risk-controlled anonymously (-412); returns an actionable error.

### bilibili_video(operation, bvid, aid, limit)
- `info` - full metadata + stats block.
- `comments` - hot top comments.
- `pages` - multi-part list (first part cid feeds transcript).

### bilibili_transcript(bvid, part_index)
Fetches a video's auto-subtitle track as plain text. Returns
`{success, data:{bvid, cid, lang, text, word_count}}`. Honest error when no
subtitles exist or they are login-gated.

### bilibili_account(operation, mid)
- `status` - reports tier (anonymous/account), always works.
- `following`, `favorites` - require a +86 login; return an honest
  `requires_login` state when logged out.

### Support
- `bilibili_help(topic)` - self-description + tool list.
- `bilibili_shutdown(confirm)` - graceful shutdown.
- `show_bilibili_trending_card(limit)`, `show_bilibili_status_card()`,
  `show_bilibili_cache_card()` - Prefab in-chat cards.

## Prompts

- `bilibili_research` - discover trending + summarise a transcript.
- `bilibili_briefing` - produce a short trend briefing.

## REST Endpoints

GET /api/health, /api/capabilities, /api/tools, /api/skills, /api/dashboard,
/api/explore/trending, /api/explore/rank, /api/explore/hot_search,
/api/search, /api/video/info, /api/video/comments, /api/video/transcript,
/api/account/status, /api/logs. POST /api/translate, /api/summarize,
/api/shutdown.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| BILIBILI_COOKIE | (empty) | Optional +86 login cookie; unlocks account tier |
| BILIBILI_API_BASE | https://api.bilibili.com | Bilibili API root |
| BILIBILI_LLM_BASE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 | Local LLM (Ollama) |
| BILIBILI_LLM_MODEL | qwen2.5:7b | Local LLM model |
| BILIBILI_CACHE_TTL | 600 | JSON cache TTL (s) |
| BILIBILI_BACKEND_PORT | 11185 | Backend port |
| BILIBILI_FRONTEND_PORT | 11186 | Frontend port |

## Install

Requirements: uv (Python 3.11+), Node + Bun (webapp).
```powershell
uv sync
.\start.ps1   # full stack, opens webapp at 127.0.0.1:11186
```

## Rate-limit etiquette

Bilibili aggressively rate-limits scrapers. Default page sizes are small and
responses are TTL-cached (default 10 min). -412 means risk control: slow
down, reuse cache, or set a cookie. Never hammer an endpoint in a loop.

## Honesty rules

- Never invent views/stats - report exactly what the API returned.
- If subtitles are unavailable or login-gated, say so - do not fabricate a
  transcript.
- Account-tier data (following, favorites) requires real auth; no mock data.

## Troubleshooting

- -412 / "risk control blocked": slow down or set a cookie.
- -101 "not logged in": endpoint needs a login cookie.
- "No subtitle tracks available": creator disabled captions, or login-gated.
- summarize returns not-configured: start Ollama or set the LLM env vars.
- Webapp shows MOCK content: expected until a cookie is set (mock-until-onboarded).
